control_model.field: C2 null field n(q) with one isolated zero at q=0 and n(q) nonzero on each punctured side
control_model.ownership: repository-owned affine first-jet control, not a source-owned full-carrier bridge

direction_switch.punctured_factorization: n(q)=r_plus(q)*(1,1) for q>0 and r_minus(q)*(1,-1) for q<0 after relabeling the distinct-line horn
direction_switch.c2_matching: n(0)=n'(0)=n''(0)=0 because each common jet lies in both distinct null lines and their intersection is zero
direction_switch.minimum_generic_order: a C2 direction switch is invisible through second order; the first nonzero one-sided jet can occur at order three
direction_switch.witness_regular_grade: C2 but not C3 at q=0
direction_switch.same_line_contrast: if both punctured sides use the same null line, no jet-flatness follows from line matching

shear_matching.simple_zero_continuous_lift: for C1 r and tilde_w with r(0)=tilde_w(0)=0 and r'(0) nonzero, w=tilde_w/r extends continuously with w(0)=tilde_w'(0)/r'(0)
shear_matching.nondivisible_horn: tilde_w(0) nonzero forces a pole in w even when the product n*w is written regularly in unscaled coordinates
shear_matching.switched_line_result: bounded one-sided shear amplitudes are annihilated by the order-three zero through the complete C2 jet; bridge regularity supplies no invertible amplitude transport across the interface
shear_matching.extra_matching_owner: any relation between the two one-sided amplitudes is independent boundary, action, gauge or domain data

mass_control.signature_11_consequence: n^perp=span(n), so b lies on N_plus for q>0 and N_minus for q<0
mass_control.interface_consequence: continuity forces b(0)=0 when the two null lines differ
mass_control.kinetic_consequence: on each side T and all first derivatives relevant to the affine first-jet kinetic density stay on one fixed null line, so the controlled kinetic density vanishes; continuity preserves zero at the crossing
mass_control.verdict: a C2 zero-mediated direction switch does not escape the nondegenerate signature-(1,1) mass-control collapse
